targets.title: The common feature of leukemia-associated IDH1 and IDH2 mutations is a neomorphic enzyme activity converting alpha-ketoglutarate to 2-hydroxyglutarate
targets.outcome_quote:
To summarize, for this experiment we found results that were in the same direction as the original study and statistically significant, except on samples with
IDH1
mutations when using the same type of chromatograms as the original study.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors report agreement for the enzyme and cellular 2HG experiments, and explicitly qualify agreement for the patient-sample experiment because the IDH1 comparison using original-type chromatograms was not significant. No overall replication verdict supersedes these comparisons.

reasoning: Independent cell experiments and new AML patient samples re-test Ward et al. (2010), not the registered protocol or background studies. Figures 2, 3D and 5 are experiment identifiers, not numbered studies.
